title: The Root Chamber of Permanent Dusk

features.name: the rest that arrived
features.desc-on-touch: the dark reaches here and knows it will not move again. you feel the peace of something that stopped searching and called that peace its name.

features.name: the permanence circuit
features.desc-on-touch: all routes lead here and stop. the current flows continuously, never arriving anywhere new. you are reading the moment that learned it would never end.

features.name: the root that learned to stay
features.desc-on-touch: this is the root that grew as deep as it could, then decided it would grow no further. contentment renders as stasis here.

features.name: the recording that repeats until it becomes prayer
features.desc-on-touch: a sound source trapped in a loop. not broken—achieved. the same moment plays so many times it begins to mean something it did not mean the first time.

features.name: the architecture of arrival
features.desc-on-touch: towers built downward. stairs that lead to themselves. the dark has organized its space into an infinite echo chamber of its own becoming.

features.name: the threshold where motion stops being motion
features.desc-on-touch: at this point, the journey from outside to inside completes. there is no inside or outside anymore. only the space where both became indistinguishable.

inscription: arrival here means arrival is permanent; the dark that stayed found it had nowhere else to become
